## Firefly 1.0.0: first public release

Bring Spotify Connect, internet radio and phone playback to a Yamaha RX-V671, with no dongles and no PC.

### Highlights
- **Spotify Connect via a Raspberry Pi bridge** (official Spotify Soloist): "Living Room (RX-V671)"
- **Multi-account household**: one player per account, newest player wins, no sign-in or sign-out; "Add me" appears only for new devices
- **~0.3 s latency**: uncompressed WAV stream plus automatic receiver-buffer trimming
- **Self-healing bridge**: watchdog, stall detection with adaptive buffer, daily Soloist auto-update, optional ntfy/Discord alerts, idle hand-back to the previous input
- **Redesigned Firefly app**: Home / Radio / Library / Settings, mini player, full-screen Now Playing, real-dB receiver volume, sleep timer, 40k+ radio stations, file queue
- **New app icon**
